summary: Iteration 2: retested POST /api/sales (now 200, fixed) + full backend CRUD (categories, products, stock adjust, purchases, settings below-cost guard, backup export/import roundtrip) via pytest (13 tests, 11 pass). Full frontend E2E on all 10 pages via Playwright. One CRITICAL bug found: purchases created with received=true (the DEFAULT in the UI) never add stock. One minor 500 on regex special chars in product search. Several minor design issues.

critical.issue: Stock and cost_price are NOT updated. create_purchase inserts the doc with status='diterima' and then calls _receive_purchase(), which returns early because status is already 'diterima'. Verified via API (stock stayed 20 instead of 25) and UI (Pembelian modal with default checked 'Tandai sudah diterima' -> status Diterima but Gula stock stayed 40). No 'pembelian' stock movement recorded either. Fix: insert with status 'menunggu' and let _receive_purchase flip it, or apply stock update inline.

minor.issue: Returns 500 - q is passed unescaped into $regex (invalid regex). Use re.escape(q). Kasir search box / Barang search will 500 if user types '(' '[' '*' etc.
totals.discount only sums global_discount; per-line item discounts are excluded from 'Diskon' total (Laporan showed Rp2.500 while actual discounts were Rp8.000).
Auto code uses timestamp%100000 - no uniqueness check; barcode uniqueness also not enforced (duplicate barcodes make by-barcode lookup ambiguous).

ui_bugs.issue: Default 'Tandai sudah diterima' checked -> due to backend bug, every default purchase is marked Diterima without adding stock (data corruption for inventory).

issues: Search icon overlaps placeholder text ('Cari' renders as 'ari nama/kode...'). The .input class padding overrides Tailwind pl-9 - use !pl-9 or adjust CSS order.

Title is pushed down and the quick-period buttons, date inputs and CSV button are stacked vertically with full-width date inputs in the right half - header layout broken (should be a single row toolbar).
Overlay does not cover the top ~13px of the viewport (white strip visible above dimmed area).
Native browser date pickers (input type=date, shows mm/dd/yyyy format in en locale) instead of shadcn Calendar; not Indonesian format.
Harga Modal/Harga Jual inputs show raw '5000' without thousand separators, inconsistent with Kasir/Pembelian inputs which show '15.500'.
Rp200.000 quick-cash button wraps alone onto a second line at 1920px.

critical_code_review_comments: create_purchase/_receive_purchase status check makes received=true a no-op (see critical)
create_sale is not atomic: stock check and $inc are separate; concurrent sales can oversell. Use conditional update {stock: {$gte: qty}}
Dates use UTC for 'today' while UI shows WIB; sales between 00:00-07:00 WIB fall into previous UTC day on Beranda/Laporan/Riwayat
tax_percent is trusted from client instead of settings.tax_percent
backup_import deletes all collections before inserting with no validation/transaction - a malformed payload can wipe data
server.py is 860 lines - consider splitting into routers

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows work; purchase received-by-default flow corrupts stock)

rca of the issue: POST /api/purchases received=true: doc['status'] = 'diterima' if data.received is set BEFORE insert; then _receive_purchase() checks `if pur.get('status') == 'diterima': return` and exits without touching stock. Repro: POST /api/purchases {received:true, items:[{product_id, qty:5, cost_price:1500}]} -> status 'diterima', product stock unchanged. Mitigation: always insert with status 'menunggu' then await _receive_purchase(pur_id).
